data.eligibility_information:
Qualification: BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering or
Electronics & Communication Engineering. Where ECE is not a standalone
department, Electrical Engineering may be considered if demonstrably
equivalent to ECE.

Stream continuity: For ME/M.Tech in EC/CS, BE/B.Tech must also be EC/CS;
cross-stream combinations are not considered.

Academic thresholds: Minimum 70% or 7.0/10 CGPA in B.E/B.Tech and in the
highest qualification acquired. Screening will consider up to 6th semester for
UG and up to 2nd semester for PG; final eligibility requires overall 70%/7.0
CGPA upon completion.

Attempts/backlogs: No backlogs; all subjects in every qualification must be
cleared in the first and single attempt.

Nationality: Indian nationals only.

Age criteria (as on 01 August 2026):

For BE/BTech:
a) GEN/EWS Category : Not exceeding 25 years.
b) OBC Category : Not exceeding 28 years.
c) SC/ST/PH Category : Not exceeding 30 years.

For ME/Mtech:
a) GEN/EWS Category : Not exceeding 27 years.
b) OBC Category : Not exceeding 30 years.
c) SC/ST/PH Category : Not exceeding 32 years.
data.additional_information:
ROLE TITLE: SCIENTIST-‘B’ (Electronics & Communication Engineering)
Key accountabilities:

• Understanding product requirements, architecting, a suitable solution aften an
analysis of different alternatives.
• Design and/or testing of a board, including PCB design in CAD tool
environment. The board would typically be a microprocessor based board,
with a variety of electrical and optical network interfaces, and could involve
RF/DSP/Fibre-optical system components/network processors, etc.
• Desing, coding, simulation and testing of FPGA/PLD
• Testing of the design and design related procured components eg. Optical
modules, amplifiers, couplers, etc.
• Validation of a product/solution and ensuring its working in the customer
environment.
• Documentation of the design, to facilitate mass production of the design and
technology transfer.

Role requirement behaviors: Team spirit, proficiency towards using latest hardware
design and testing tools

ROLE TITLE: SCIENTIST- ‘B’ (Computer Science Engineering)
Key accountabilities:

• Well versed with computer network and system programming having excellent
software development skills and problem tackling approach.
• Sound base in computer design and architecture.
• Basic knowledge in RISC, CISC architecture types, and variants of
processors based on Intel, MIPS and Power PC.
• In depth knowledge in operating system concepts viz memory management,
disk scheduling, multithreading, parallel processing, use of semaphores and
tackling different deadlock situations, ways to detect and avoid them optimally.
• Developer having decent knowledge in database concepts and normalization,
having concrete idea about use of ER diagrams.
• Expertise in C/C++/Python/MEAN stack programming and sound knowledge
in optimum algorithm and design patterns.
• Expertise in objective C & Swift is desirable.
• Exposure in J2SE, J2EE, web technologies and Linux environment is
desirable.
• Exposure to Basic data science, NLP, Machine Learning, Deep Learning
(CNN,RNN,LSTM) is desirable

Role requirement behaviors: Analytical thinking, Learning Ability, Teamwork,
Continuous Learning
